primary_comparison: event minus fixed, unweighted mean of seven within-conversation question-level all-evidence success rates at 1024 retrieved words
secondary_comparisons: session baseline; 512 and 2048 word budgets; categories 1,2,4; single versus multiple gold turns; same versus different gold sessions
uncertainty: descriptive paired conversation differences and exploratory exact two-sided sign-flip over seven paired differences; no inference from 599 independent questions
cost_proxies: number of indexed segments, source text words, average retrieved words and retrieved segments; no API calls or hardware runtime comparison
no_retuning: Do not change segmentation, ranker, budget, eligibility or selection after seeing held-out labels. Error analysis is descriptive only.
